name: Steal an Anime Girl
story: In a world where countless anime universes collide, heroes and villains coexist in chaos. But hidden in the shadows is a figure whispered about in every realm — The Thief, a legend known for one thing: stealing the most iconic anime girls from across dimensions. Now, you are their successor. Armed with skill, charm, and a bit of luck, you’ll infiltrate one anime world after another — stealing characters once thought untouchable. But every heist has its risks. Rival thieves, guardians, and vengeful heroes will stop at nothing to take back what you’ve stolen. Will you become the next legend… or just another thief lost to the void?
gameplay: Steal an Anime Girl is a fast-paced sneak and collection simulator with light strategy and action elements. Your mission: infiltrate anime worlds, avoid detection, and steal your favorite heroines before anyone notices. Build your exclusive vault of stolen characters, upgrade your thief skills, and defend your collection from rival players trying to take them back. Each character brings unique bonuses and powers that enhance your future heists and unlock deeper layers of the game. Master stealth, speed, and cunning as you climb the ranks of the underworld. In a universe where every anime realm collides, only one thief can own it all.

name: Steal a Sneakers
story: In a city where hype is everything, sneakers aren’t just shoes — they’re power, status, and obsession. You start as a street-level thief with nothing but speed, style, and a dream: to steal the rarest kicks and build a sneaker empire that the city will never forget. But every heist comes with risk. Rival thieves lurk in the shadows, ready to snatch your loot and take your crown. Only the smartest, fastest, and boldest will rise from the alleys to the top of the sneaker underworld. Will you become the ultimate sneaker legend… or lose it all chasing hype?
gameplay: Sneaker Thief is a fast-paced urban heist simulator where every move counts. 👟 Sneak through the city to steal legendary sneakers hidden across the map. 💰 Sell and collect your loot to expand your sneaker stash. 🏪 Upgrade your shop to showcase your rare finds and flex your growing empire. 🛡️ Defend your collection from rival thieves who want what’s yours. ⚡ Rebirth and unlock new abilities to steal faster, smarter, and cleaner than ever before. Every sneaker tells a story. Every heist builds your legend. Are you ready to rule the streets as the ultimate sneaker thief?

name: Steal an Army
story: In a world where power is everything, you start with nothing but determination and a single recruit. The land is ruled by rival generals, each commanding massive armies and unstoppable machines of war. To survive, you must build your own army — not just by recruiting, but by stealing troops, tanks, and choppers from others. Every battle strengthens your forces and brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate Army General. But remember — in this world, loyalty is earned, and armies can be taken just as easily as they’re built.
gameplay: Steal an Army combines base-building, combat, and chaos in a fast-paced military simulation! Recruit soldiers, expand your base, and raid other players to steal their troops and vehicles. Use your earnings to upgrade weapons, unlock troll gear, and strengthen your defenses. Rebirth to boost your stats and dominate the battlefield even faster. Whether you prefer strategy or pure chaos, every choice you make defines your rise to power.

name: Mount Halimun
story: Hidden deep within the misty rainforests of West Java lies Mount Halimun — a legendary peak closed to the public to protect its sacred wilderness. But in this world, you’re given a rare chance to explore what few have ever seen. Step into the heart of the jungle, listen to the whisper of the wind, and uncover the mountain’s hidden stories. Every trail tells a tale, every discovery connects you closer to nature, and every step brings you nearer to the summit shrouded in legend.
gameplay: Mount Halimun HD offers a breathtaking blend of adventure, exploration, and education. Immerse yourself in stunning HD visuals as you traverse misty forests and rugged trails. Record your progress in the Mountain Journal, collect educational articles about nature and conservation, and uncover hidden knowledge along the way. Bring your friends on the journey — carry each other through tough paths, share discoveries, and capture unforgettable moments at the peak. This is more than a climb; it’s a journey of friendship, discovery, and respect for nature’s untold beauty.

name: Throw My Ride!
story: In a world where speed alone isn’t enough, one challenge reigns supreme — how far can you throw your car? You’re a daring mechanic-turned-launcher, obsessed with pushing machines beyond their limits. From scrap junkers to supercars, every vehicle is a new experiment in chaos, flight, and distance. It’s not just about driving anymore… it’s about launching your ride into the stratosphere and proving you’ve got what it takes to defy gravity itself.
gameplay: Throw My Ride is a physics-based car-launching simulator where power meets precision! Load your car into a massive slingshot, fire it across wild landscapes, and watch it bounce, flip, and soar for record-breaking distances. Earn rewards based on how far you travel, then use them to upgrade your car, slingshot, and launch tower. Unlock new vehicles, explore extreme zones, and perfect your timing to reach impossible heights. Every launch brings you closer to the ultimate goal — the farthest throw in the world!

name: Mount Nirwana
story: High above the clouds lies Mount Nirwana, a mystical peak known as the “Roof of Heaven. Legends say that those who reach its summit will find inner peace and hear the whispers of the wind that carries ancient secrets. You are one of the few brave souls chosen to ascend this sacred mountain — not for glory, but for understanding. As you climb through misty forests, glowing valleys, and tranquil skies, you’ll uncover fragments of forgotten stories about the bond between nature and the human spirit. Each step brings you closer to enlightenment… and to the breathtaking serenity that only Nirwana can offer.
gameplay: Gunung Nirwana HD blends exploration, learning, and social adventure in one immersive mountain-climbing experience. 🏔️ Explore & Discover: Trek through tropical forests, misty cliffs, and luminous peaks rendered in stunning HD detail. 📖 Record Your Journey: Keep an Adventure Journal that logs your milestones, discoveries, and photos from each expedition. 🧠 Learn & Grow: Collect educational insights and real-world mountaineering facts as you progress. 🤝 Climb Together: Team up with friends to explore, carry each other through challenges, and share unforgettable moments at the summit. Find your calm, embrace the challenge, and uncover the hidden beauty of Mount Nirwana — where peace meets adventure. 🌤️

name: Mount Kalcer
story: Gunung Kalcer bukan gunung biasa — ia hanya muncul di bawah cahaya bulan. Konon, siapa pun yang berhasil mencapai puncaknya akan menemukan arti sejati dari “malam yang hidup”. Kamu dan teman-temanmu memulai perjalanan menuju puncak mistis ini, menembus kabut tebal, melintasi lembah bercahaya, dan menghadapi makhluk bayangan yang menjaga rahasia gunung. Namun, semakin tinggi kamu mendaki, semakin nyata keajaiban yang menunggu di atas sana — tempat di mana bintang, musik, dan persahabatan bersatu di bawah bulan sabit besar..
gameplay: Gunung Kalcer adalah game petualangan sosial penuh misteri dan fantasi. Jelajahi jalur malam yang indah, hindari rintangan, dan gunakan kekuatan unik seperti berubah menjadi rusa ajaib atau terbang di langit berbintang. Bekerjasama dengan teman untuk melewati jalan berbahaya, membawa satu sama lain melewati jurang, dan menaklukkan monster bayangan yang menghalangi jalan menuju puncak. Nikmati momen santai di atas gunung — berfoto, berjoget, atau sekadar menatap ribuan bintang setelah perjalanan panjangmu. Setiap langkah membawa kisah baru, dan setiap puncak adalah kenangan tak terlupakan.

name: Mount Renjana
story: Welcome to Mount Renjana, a mountain where every step echoes with emotion. This is not just a climb — it’s a heartfelt journey through nature’s beauty, longing, and self-discovery. As the sun pierces through the misty forests and the wind whispers across the cliffs, you’ll feel the mountain calling to your soul. Each trail tells a story of love, loss, and hope — guiding you toward the true summit: the peak of your own heart. Mount Renjana is where silence speaks, memories awaken, and nature embraces your spirit. Will you find peace at the top, or discover something even deeper within yourself?
gameplay: 🌿 Explore and Discover: Traverse breathtaking HD landscapes filled with serene forests, glowing valleys, and mist-covered cliffs. 🧭 Emotional Journey: Uncover hidden messages, journal entries, and visual stories that connect your climb to the mountain’s soul. 🤝 Social Adventure: Invite friends to join your ascent, share quiet moments, or reach the summit together under the golden sky. 📖 Journey Log: Record your milestones and reflections in your personal climbing journal — your memories will stay forever on Mount Renjana. Mount Renjana isn’t just about reaching the top — it’s about finding the meaning of the climb itself. 🌙

name: Beach Party
story: is an open-air festival map featuring vibrant neon lights, a futuristic DJ booth, and a large main stage under the night sky. The entire area is filled with festival decorations like hanging lights, glowing bars, cozy outdoor lounges, and a wide dance floor. The atmosphere is energetic, modern, and perfect for players to chill and party together.
gameplay: 🕺Dance & Expression System: Players can choose from a variety of dance moves and expressions to show off their style on the dance floor & Synchronized Dance. 🗺️ Explore Outdoor Map : Aesthetic neon photo spots let players take cool avatar snapshots with a stylish night backdrop. 😎 Social Hangout: Comfortable lounge areas let players chat, sit, and interact freely without the loud crowd.

name: Speed Limit Sim
story: 🏎️ Speed Limit Simulator: GET FLASHED! 📸 Welcome to the wildest racing game on Roblox! Start with a slow car, train up, and turn into a supersonic beast! 🚀
gameplay: 💥 Break the Limit: Drive so fast the Police Radars BLOW UP! 🚓 Don't get Caught: A cop car is right behind you... keep moving! 🐶 Pet System: Hatch eggs to get multipliers! 🎨Customize: Cool skins, neon trails, and wild auras!

name: Mancing Mania
story: Sate Anomali is a game about a satay seller who is placed on a quiet and haunted street with strange, mysterious buyers and ghosts.
gameplay: Keep selling satay until the target is met. Don't let the anomalies bother you.

name: Bungee Jump
story: 🧠 Dive, Grab, Get Rich! 🪢💸 🕹️ How to Play 🎯 Leap from the edge and aim for the rarest brainrots on the lower platforms! 🧺 Collect as many as you can before your bungee cord pulls you back up. 🚀 Upgrade everything to reach deeper levels and unlock the ultimate brainrot collection!
gameplay: ✨ Level Up Your Gameplay 📏 Longer Ropes: Reach the deepest, most legendary platforms! ⚡ Hyper Speed: Dive and bounce back faster to grind even more money. 🎒 Max Capacity: Carry a mountain of brainrot in a single jump. 🏰 Base Upgrades: Build the ultimate headquarters to boost your earnings! 🌈 Collect special mutated brainrots for massive multipliers!
